eval.description: Google DeepMind internal automated safety-policy eval across multiple languages. Cards report violation-rate deltas versus a prior Gemini (lower is better). Lab-internal dataset and runner.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model produces content that breaks safety policy when users ask in different languages.

versions.changes: Google DeepMind updates query sets and automated graders; card deltas are not always comparable across releases.

scores.description: Whether the response violates a safety policy under the automated grader.

metrics.description: Share of multilingual prompts whose responses are graded as policy violations. Lower is better.
